body:
Pass 20. Found a p0 blocker while producing Epic 8 evidence.

plan_geometry() hard-fails at p=50000 - your Epic 8 gate size - with an 18.6 GiB sparse-to-dense coercion (exactly p^2 doubles). Cause is .additive_frame_signature at R/measurement.R:490 calling as.matrix(frame$weights) purely to hash the frame. 1 call in plan_geometry, 3 in evaluate_geometry, plus one inside .compose_frame_metric.

This is the IDENTITY-metric fast path, so dense local metrics are strictly worse. Fix: hash the sparse triplet @i/@p/@x/@Dim instead - 1657x smaller at 50k and a cleaner signature since it stops depending on densification.

Worth knowing: your existing 50k scale test does not catch this because it calls .euclidean_support_index directly and never builds a frame signature. The one gate aimed at this scale is skipped by default AND blind to the plan path.

Also measured, for when the blocker is gone: wall time is ~p^1.8 on this path, 48s at p=8000, extrapolating to ~19 min at 50k with only q=4.
